notes.title: NYC live starts
notes.content: Mostly just introduces NYC. Interviews a few students / intro video. Interviews pastor Shawn Evans (part of NYI council chair). Talked about why NYC happens and why it's a thing / why it's so important. Introduced Lamoras the preacher. Talks about participating in NYC; done just be a spectator actually pray with them worship be a part of it.

notes.title: Intro video
notes.content: Intro into the service and hints at the what the service is going to be about. There is beauty is living water

notes.title: Worship starts
Grace Like a Wave by Elevation Worship
King of Kings by Hillsong Worship
Intro to band
notes.content: The main singer kinda introduces the band and also is asking to get into a more serious version of worship. All of the co host pastors speak in between each of them there Is __Cloud by Elevation Worship__ is sung. Brady Braatz (NYC live guy) does a small talk on **remember your longing for relief**. Shane Lima talks about the **familiarity of pain**. Antonio Marshall talked about **soaking up God's abundance love**. Stephanie Lobdell talks about the **fear of the unknown, you may feel tossed but remember you are carried by the current of Christ flooded by the relentless love of God**. Antonio Marshall talks again about **receiving all that God has to offer during NYC**. Then all the co host pastors pray together. Lastly they talk about why their band is called royal company, which is because **when you are worshiping you are in the true presence of the one true king God**.

notes.title: Take You at Your Word by Cody Carnes
Vidio prior to sermon starts
notes.content: Video with ~~God or Jesus~~ speaking about how harsh the world is. How his love overflows for you, remember where your help come from, he is always there for you

Son of Suffering by Maverick City Music

LaMoris Crawford walks onstage
notes.content: starts with a one liner Jesus making it to the cross wasn't a tragedy it was an accomplishment.

notes.title: It doesn't matter how you start in life you only matters how you finish
Sermon notes When in drought
notes.content:
@1:10:25 Talks about him, and part of his story.
Basketball was an escape for him.

You are not here by accident you are here to leave your mark. It doesn't matter your story God created us. **YOU** are made in his image. Jesus had to do what Adam couldn't. 

The bible is filled with imagery of water. In this imagery we begin to see God's story, a story that   tells we were created to be filled with rivers of God's abundance life. 

The difference between us and the world is we have God with us. The world has no hope because they have a hole that only God can fill. 

@1:22:26  

1st principle: A place with not water is a place with no life.
     __ALL__ scripture is given by inspiration by 
God. The earth cries out for God.

Millionaires have everything but still don't have peace in their soul. Peace comes from a spirit filled life.

notes.title: At the end of popularity is emptiness
Don't lose you for people you are never going to see
The tragedy of life isn't dying, it's going past the cemetery and thinking of things that never came to be.
Genesis 1:1-2
notes.content: ^^1^^ In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth. ^^2^^ The earth was without form, and void; and darkness was on the face of the deep. And the spirit of God was hovering over the face of the waters.

notes.title: He has a desire to keep you thirsty for things that can't satisfy you
We don't follow God and get mad at God when trouble comes
You can't be tempted by something you don't desire
